Recommendation: I recommend that the University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees approve the FY2026 Total Budget Request for submission to the State Office of Management and Budget. Points to Consider: The FY2026 total budget request for URI is $1.13B. Within this, the FY2026 State General Appropriations request is $146.2M and includes the following components: FY25 Enacted Operating Budget $110.8M Anticipated Operating Shortfall $5.7M Current Service Level $21.6M Strategic Initiatives $13.6M Total $151.7 Anticipated tuition & fee/misc revenue ($5.5M) Total FY26 Budget Request $146.2M The FY2026 General Appropriations includes a $13.6M request for Strategic Initiatives, which includes the following critical operating budget components, in alignment with the Focus URI Strategic Plan: SP1: Broaden Our Impact (Life Sciences Faculty and remaining land-grant state support) $5.3M SP2: Enhance Student Achievement (Academic Advisors) $2.0M SP3: Foster an Inclusive Culture (Support for TD Program, National Guard & Tribal scholarship support) $2.3M SP4: Power the University of the Future (IT Modernization) $4.0M Total $13.6M
